notes: v1.14.547 — LEGACY-RETIRE STAGE 6.3: CLI/IB IS DECOUPLED. The whole pg-cli surface (IB/NDR, OOB, Console, Test & Cert, Parser strips and their five cli-sub panels — 380 lines) is now AUTHORED inside #rf-cli instead of being drained there at boot. redesign_homeCLI and its registration are deleted, the third of eight re-homes and the FIRST of the four drain-and-wipe kind, and the pg-cli shell goes with them. ⭐ The markup was MOVED programmatically, not retyped, so all 380 lines are byte-identical; every id is verbatim because showStab and STAB_GROUPS[cli-sub] resolve them by id. ⛔ THE DOM MOVE IS GONE BUT THE BINDING IS NOT: the re-home also called initSubtab, which sets the default IB/NDR panel and wires the group to the strip at its NEW location. Authoring markup does not bind subtabs — dropping that call would open the tab with every panel hidden, silently, which is exactly the empty-surface failure 45-borrowed-organs exists to catch. It is kept, at the same DOMContentLoaded timing it always had. The legacy initSubtab line in showPage went with pg-cli: its #pg-cli selector matched nothing once the page was deleted. ⚠ VISIBLE UNDER ?legacy=1: the legacy house loses CLI/IB, the third organ to go. Two legacy doors are now stranded — a stab inside pg-fiber (itself organ 6.4) and legacy search results routing by page id. They dead-tap rather than explain, and the honest fix is one change to showPage, not a patch per door. Logged as a finding for its own ship, because showPage is the central router and deserves its own verify.
